sec01-card-sec01-F01.front: What document does a brand-new driver have to get before practicing on Pennsylvania roads?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.expected_back: A first-time applicant must obtain a learner permit before beginning to drive in Pennsylvania.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.front: Which three evaluations do you have to pass to earn a Pennsylvania driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.expected_back: Obtaining a driver license requires passing vision, knowledge and road tests.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.front: How long does your learner application form stay good once your doctor completes the physical?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.expected_back: Form DL-one hundred eighty remains valid for one year after the physical examination.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.front: How soon ahead of your sixteenth birthday can you get the medical physical for your permit form?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.memory_hook: Physical up to six months early
sec01-card-sec01-F04.expected_back: The physical examination for the learner application may occur no earlier than six months before the applicant turns sixteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.front: How old do you have to be before submitting a non-commercial learner permit application in Pennsylvania?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.expected_back: An applicant must reach age sixteen before applying for a non-commercial learner permit.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.front: Which part of the learner application form does your health care provider have to fill out?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.expected_back: The health care provider must complete the reverse side of the DL-one hundred eighty application.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.front: What can the examiner do if it is unclear whether your application satisfies Pennsylvania medical standards?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.expected_back: An examiner who cannot determine whether the application meets medical standards may delay the permit and require further medical examinations.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.front: What special permit and training setup might PennDOT require if an applicant has a seriously impairing condition?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.expected_back: A seriously impairing condition may require a dual control learner permit and instruction from a certified instructor.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.front: Who is allowed to complete the parent or guardian consent form for an applicant under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.expected_back: For an applicant younger than eighteen, DL-180TD must be completed by a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.front: What has to happen if the consenting adult cannot come with a minor applicant to the center?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.expected_back: If the adult providing consent cannot accompany the applicant, that adult must sign DL-180TD before a notary.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.front: Along with valid identification, what extra proof is needed for consent paperwork when last names do not match?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.expected_back: Consent documentation requires proper identification and, when surnames differ, evidence of the relationship.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.front: How many residency documents does an applicant over age eighteen need to bring?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.expected_back: Applicants older than eighteen must provide two residency proofs.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.front: How do you submit your finished learner application form once the physical is complete?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.expected_back: The completed DL-one hundred eighty application must be brought to the Driver License Center rather than mailed.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.front: What additional signed form does an applicant under eighteen have to carry in on testing day?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.expected_back: An applicant younger than eighteen must also bring the completed DL-180TD consent form for testing.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.front: Why do your birth-date and identity records have to be original documents at the licensing center?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.expected_back: Documents establishing birth date and identity must be originals because photocopies are not accepted.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.front: Which federal number card belongs in your folder when visiting for the knowledge test?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.expected_back: The items required for the knowledge-test visit include the applicant's Social Security card.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.front: How should you prepare to pay the required fee when heading in for your permit?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.expected_back: The applicant must bring the applicable fee and consult the application for accepted payment methods.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.front: Where can you find the list of accepted birth-date IDs and exact permit fees?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.expected_back: The back of DL-one hundred eighty lists acceptable birth-date identification and the fees.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.front: When does the Driver License Center run a vision screening during your visit?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.expected_back: The Driver License Center tests vision if a health care provider or optometrist has not already done so.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.front: What should you pack for your test visit if you normally wear glasses or contacts?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.expected_back: Applicants who use corrective lenses should bring their glasses or contact lenses to the test visit.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.front: Once you pass the knowledge test, how long is the newly issued learner permit valid?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.expected_back: After the knowledge test is passed, the examiner issues a learner permit valid for one year.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.front: At what exact point are you legally allowed to start behind-the-wheel driving practice?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.expected_back: Driving practice may begin when the learner permit has been received.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.front: When does PennDOT advise young drivers to book their road test, and what date rule applies?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.expected_back: PennDOT recommends that young drivers book the road test when they receive the permit, with a test date no earlier than the permit's eligibility date.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.front: How many total behind-the-wheel practice hours must a driver under eighteen finish before taking the road test?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.expected_back: Before a road test, an applicant younger than eighteen needs at least sixty-five hours of driving practice behind the wheel.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.front: Out of the required teen practice hours, at least how many have to take place at night?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.expected_back: For applicants younger than eighteen, the required driving practice includes at least ten hours at night.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.front: At least how many behind-the-wheel hours must an under-eighteen applicant log in bad weather?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.expected_back: For applicants younger than eighteen, the required driving practice includes at least five hours in bad weather.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.front: Who is qualified to ride in the front passenger seat to supervise a permit holder?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.expected_back: A learner must always have a licensed supervisor in the front seat who is at least twenty-one, or a licensed parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.front: How do available seat belts limit passenger numbers for any driver under age eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.expected_back: A driver younger than eighteen must not carry more passengers than the vehicle has seat belts.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.front: What waiting period and signed hour breakdown must a young learner complete before taking the road test?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.expected_back: A young learner must wait six months after permit issue and have signed certification of the required sixty-five practice hours, including at least ten at night and five in bad weather, before the road test.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.front: Which form handles extending, replacing, or updating a non-commercial permit after expiration or three road-test failures?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.expected_back: An expired learner permit or three unsuccessful road tests can lead to using DL-thirty-one to add, extend, replace, change or correct the non-commercial permit.

sec01-card-sec01-F31.front: Who should you check with before practicing in another state on a Pennsylvania learner permit?
sec01-card-sec01-F31.expected_back: Before using a Pennsylvania learner permit in another state, check its validity with the insurer and that state's transportation department.

sec01-card-sec01-F32.front: What must an applicant bring to the examiner if details on the learner permit need correcting?
sec01-card-sec01-F32.expected_back: An applicant correcting permit information should bring supporting proof to the examiner at the testing visit.

sec01-card-sec01-F33.front: How many times can you take the knowledge test in a single day, even if you drive to another center?
sec01-card-sec01-F33.expected_back: Only one knowledge-test attempt is permitted in a day, even when the testing location changes.

sec01-card-sec01-F34.front: Why must you hang on to your returned application and consent sheets if you do not pass the knowledge test?
sec01-card-sec01-F34.expected_back: After a failed knowledge test, retain the returned application and consent forms because they must be brought to the next test.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.front: What optional designation are drivers asked about whenever they renew a Pennsylvania license?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.expected_back: At license renewal, the applicant is asked whether the license should carry an organ-donor designation.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.front: What happens on your card when you say yes to organ donation at the Photo License Center?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.expected_back: Saying yes to organ-donor designation at the Photo License Center puts that designation on the driver license.

sec01-card-sec01-R03.front: What requirement must an applicant under eighteen meet to get the organ-donor designation?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.expected_back: An applicant younger than eighteen may obtain organ-donor designation only with written consent from a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.front: Where can an adult mark organ-donor permission for an applicant under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.expected_back: The adult may give a minor's organ-donor consent through the appropriate box on DL-180TD.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.front: How can you add organ-donor status through PennDOT online between renewals, and what does the site provide?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.expected_back: The organ-donor designation can also be added to the driver record through PennDOT's website, which offers a card to print and carry with the license.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.front: How does an applicant include a voluntary organ-donation awareness contribution when licensing?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.expected_back: A voluntary organ-donation awareness contribution is marked on the license form and included with the license-fee payment.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.front: What service and discharge standard qualifies an applicant for the veteran designation on a license?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.expected_back: Veteran designation requires qualifying service, including reserve or National Guard service, with discharge or release under conditions other than dishonorable.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.front: How is a voluntary Veterans' Trust Fund contribution handled alongside your regular licensing fee?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.expected_back: A voluntary Veterans' Trust Fund contribution is additional to the licensing fee and should be identified by the proper form box.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.front: Why does PennDOT collect your Social Security number, height, and eye color when you apply?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.expected_back: PennDOT collects the applicant's Social Security number, height and eye color as identifying information to reduce license fraud.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.front: How is your Social Security number treated when someone views your public Pennsylvania driver record?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.expected_back: The Social Security number is excluded from the public driver record.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.front: Does your Social Security number appear on the front or back of a Pennsylvania permit or license?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.expected_back: A Social Security number is not displayed on the learner permit or driver license.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.front: Can someone with poor sight in one eye still get licensed, and what restrictions might apply?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.expected_back: Poor sight in one eye does not necessarily prevent licensing, though corrective lenses, daytime-only driving or side mirrors may be required.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.front: Which report form does the examiner hand you if your eyesight falls short of screening standards?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.expected_back: Failure to meet vision standards results in the examiner providing the DL-one hundred two eye-examination report form.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.front: Which professionals can examine your eyes and complete the vision report form before you return to test?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.expected_back: An optometrist, ophthalmologist or family physician should examine vision and complete DL-one hundred two before the applicant returns to continue testing.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.front: How long can a visitor drive in Pennsylvania using a valid foreign driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.expected_back: A valid foreign license authorizes Pennsylvania driving for up to one year after entry into the United States or until that license expires, whichever is earlier.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.front: Is an international driving permit mandatory for someone driving in Pennsylvania on a valid foreign license?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.expected_back: For a foreign-license holder, an international driving permit is recommended but is not required.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.front: Holders of valid non-commercial licenses from which four places skip knowledge and road tests via reciprocity, and what test stays?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.expected_back: Reciprocity allows valid non-commercial licenses from France, Germany, Korea or Taiwan to transfer without knowledge or road testing, while a vision test remains required.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.front: License transfers from which three jurisdictions cannot be wrapped up on the exact same day?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.expected_back: Transfers from Puerto Rico, France or Germany cannot be completed within the same day.

sec01-card-sec01-R19.front: What credential do Pennsylvania residents sixteen and older need if they want to drive a motor vehicle?
sec01-card-sec01-R19.expected_back: Pennsylvania residents aged at least sixteen who wish to operate a motor vehicle need a Pennsylvania driver license.

sec01-card-sec01-R20.front: How soon after moving in must a new resident with an out-of-state or Canadian license switch to Pennsylvania, and what happens to the old card?
sec01-card-sec01-R20.expected_back: A new Pennsylvania resident holding a valid license from another state or Canada must obtain a Pennsylvania license within sixty days of moving and surrender the former license.

sec01-card-sec01-R21.front: What do Armed Forces or stationed reserve members with a Pennsylvania legal address need to drive non-military vehicles?
sec01-card-sec01-R21.expected_back: Armed Forces personnel with a Pennsylvania legal address, including reserve members stationed there, need a driver license to operate a non-military vehicle.

sec01-card-sec01-R22.front: How long does a junior learner permit remain valid, and when does that clock start?
sec01-card-sec01-R22.expected_back: A junior learner permit lasts one year from the issue date shown on the initial permit.

sec01-card-sec01-R23.front: Where must a junior learner's licensed supervisor sit, and what age rules apply?
sec01-card-sec01-R23.expected_back: A junior learner's licensed supervisor must occupy the front seat and be at least twenty-one, or be a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-R24.front: What passenger limit applies to a junior learner regarding the vehicle's seat belts?
sec01-card-sec01-R24.expected_back: A junior learner cannot carry passengers exceeding the available seat belts.

sec01-card-sec01-R25.front: Between which hours does a junior license normally ban driving unless an authorized adult rides along or an exception applies?
sec01-card-sec01-R25.expected_back: A junior license normally prohibits driving from eleven p.m. to five a.m. unless accompanied by a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen, with additional authorized activity exceptions.

sec01-card-sec01-R26.front: Which activities let a junior driver drive during nighttime curfew, and what document must stay in the car?
sec01-card-sec01-R26.memory_hook: Carry notarized work or volunteer proof
sec01-card-sec01-R26.expected_back: A junior driver may drive during the restricted nighttime hours for public or charitable service, volunteer firefighting or employment, but must carry a notarized schedule affidavit or authorization certificate from the employer, supervisor or fire chief.

sec01-card-sec01-R27.front: Even after passing the road test, how do seat belts cap passenger numbers on a junior license?
sec01-card-sec01-R27.expected_back: A junior license holder must keep the passenger count within the number of available seat belts.

sec01-card-sec01-R28.front: During the start of a junior license without a qualifying adult aboard, how many non-immediate-family passengers under eighteen may ride along?
sec01-card-sec01-R28.expected_back: Without an accompanying parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen, a junior driver initially may carry only one non-immediate-family passenger younger than eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-R29.front: After six clean months on a junior license without an adult aboard, what does the under-eighteen non-family limit become, and what blocks that increase?
sec01-card-sec01-R29.expected_back: After six months on a junior license, the limit without an accompanying parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen rises to three non-immediate-family passengers younger than eighteen, except for a driver ever responsible in whole or part for a crash or convicted of a driving violation.

sec01-card-sec01-R30.front: Which two point or speeding triggers hand a junior driver a mandatory ninety-day suspension?
sec01-card-sec01-R30.expected_back: A junior driver receives a mandatory ninety-day suspension for reaching six points or being convicted of exceeding the posted limit by at least twenty-six miles per hour

sec01-card-sec01-R31.front: After one year on a junior license, what three requirements let a teen upgrade early to a regular license?
sec01-card-sec01-R31.expected_back: After holding a junior license for one year, a driver may seek a regular license only with an approved driver-training course, a year free of responsible crashes and Vehicle Code convictions, and consent from a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-R32.front: Which PennDOT form does an eligible junior driver submit to convert early to a regular license?
sec01-card-sec01-R32.expected_back: An eligible junior driver applies for early conversion to a regular non-commercial license with DL-fifty-nine.

sec01-card-sec01-R33.front: When does a Pennsylvania junior license automatically turn into a regular driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R33.expected_back: A junior license becomes a regular license automatically when the holder reaches eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-R34.front: What determines which driver license class you need in Pennsylvania?
sec01-card-sec01-R34.expected_back: The license class required in Pennsylvania depends on the type of vehicle operated.

sec01-card-sec01-R35.front: Which non-commercial license class and everyday vehicles does the Pennsylvania driver manual cover?
sec01-card-sec01-R35.expected_back: This handbook covers non-commercial Class C licensing for ordinary passenger vehicles, pickup trucks and vans.

sec01-card-sec01-R36.front: What minimum age and vehicle boundary define a Pennsylvania Class C driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-R36.expected_back: Class C requires a driver aged at least sixteen who has demonstrated the qualifications for vehicles outside Classes A, B and M.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.front: Which three core subjects does the Pennsylvania knowledge examination test you on?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.expected_back: The knowledge examination assesses traffic signs, Pennsylvania driving laws and safe driving practices.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.front: Which two delivery formats can you request for the knowledge exam at Pennsylvania Driver License Centers?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.expected_back: The knowledge examination offers written and audio versions on request at Driver License Centers throughout Pennsylvania.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.front: Besides English and Spanish, what broad set of eighteen languages can applicants request for the knowledge exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.expected_back: Requested knowledge-test languages include Arabic, Burmese, Chinese Mandarin, English, French, Greek, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Nepali, Polish, Russian, Somali, Spanish, Ukrainian, Urdu and Vietnamese.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.front: How soon can you take another shot at the knowledge exam if you do not pass today?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.expected_back: After failing the knowledge examination, an applicant may retest on the next business day.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.front: What exam milestone has to be completed before you can receive a valid learner permit?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.expected_back: A valid learner permit cannot be received until the knowledge examination has been passed.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.front: How many questions are on the Pennsylvania knowledge exam, and what format do they use?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.expected_back: The knowledge examination has eighteen questions with multiple-choice answers.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.front: How many questions do you have to answer right to pass the Pennsylvania knowledge examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.expected_back: An applicant passes the knowledge examination by answering fifteen questions correctly.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.front: How far in advance can a driver under eighteen schedule a Pennsylvania skills test?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.memory_hook: Schedule up to six months ahead
sec02-card-sec02-F08.expected_back: Drivers younger than eighteen may schedule a skills test up to six months ahead.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.front: Can you take a non-commercial road examination as a walk-in, or what is required first?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.expected_back: The non-commercial road examination requires an appointment.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.front: Where online can you reserve a Pennsylvania road-test appointment?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.expected_back: A road-test appointment can be scheduled through PennDOT's Driver and Vehicle Services website.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.front: How can an applicant without internet access book a Pennsylvania road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.expected_back: Applicants without internet access may schedule the road test by calling one-eight hundred-four hundred twenty-three-five thousand five hundred forty-two.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.front: Who besides PennDOT centers can give the exact same skills test, and how is pricing set?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.expected_back: PennDOT-certified third-party businesses may administer the same skills examination for a market-based fee.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.front: What personal driving credential must every road-test applicant hand to the examiner before starting?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.expected_back: A road-test applicant must show a valid learner permit to the examiner.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.front: Which signed certification form proving sixty-five practice hours must an under-eighteen applicant present at the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.expected_back: An applicant younger than eighteen must present signed parent or guardian certification on DL-180C of sixty-five hours of driving practice.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.front: What ownership and tag card must be inside the test vehicle for the examiner to inspect?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.expected_back: The road-test vehicle must have a valid registration card available for the examiner.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.front: What financial coverage proof do you have to show for the car used on your road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.expected_back: The applicant must provide proof of current insurance for the road-test vehicle.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.front: Whose driver license gets checked alongside yours at the road test, and what age rule must that person meet?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.expected_back: The accompanying person's valid license must be presented, and that person must be at least twenty-one or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis, or spouse aged at least eighteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F18.front: Are copies of required road-test documents accepted, or what rule applies at check-in?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.expected_back: The required road-test documents must be originals; copies do not qualify the applicant to be tested.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.front: Which four paperwork and windshield sticker items does the examiner verify before your road test starts?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.expected_back: Before the road test, the examiner checks current insurance, valid registration and a valid state inspection sticker, plus an emissions sticker when required.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.front: Which nine exterior and cabin equipment items does the examiner check for safe operation before your road test?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.expected_back: The examiner checks lights, horn, brakes, wipers, turn signals, mirrors, doors, seats and tires for safe operation before the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.front: What happens to your road test if any vehicle part is unsafe or misses state inspection standards?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.expected_back: An unsafe vehicle part or failure to meet state inspection standards prevents the road test from proceeding.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.front: When the test car has seat belts, what condition must they be in and who has to buckle up?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.expected_back: When the test vehicle has seat belts, they must be clean and usable, and both the applicant and examiner must wear them during the test.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.front: When does the examiner move forward to grade your behind-the-wheel driving?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.expected_back: The examiner proceeds to evaluate safe driving only after the vehicle passes its inspection.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.front: Which five on-road problems or mistakes can cause an applicant to fail the Pennsylvania road test?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.expected_back: Dangerous driving, a law violation, a crash, failure to follow examiner instructions or too many driving errors can cause road-test failure.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.front: What cabin task might the examiner ask you to perform before pulling out for the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.expected_back: The examiner may ask the applicant to demonstrate vehicle controls before the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.front: Which eight cabin switches and features could be included in the pre-drive control demonstration?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.expected_back: A control demonstration may include the horn, parking lights, high and low beams, turn signals, wipers, parking brake, hazard flashers and defroster.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.front: What happens to your road-test score if you operate any vehicle control the wrong way?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.expected_back: Incorrect operation of any vehicle control causes road-test failure.

sec02-card-sec02-R06.front: How long and how wide is the Pennsylvania parallel-parking space between the two uprights?
sec02-card-sec02-R06.expected_back: The parallel-parking task uses a space twenty-four feet long and eight feet wide between two uprights.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.front: Where inside the parallel-parking space should your car end up once you finish the maneuver?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.expected_back: During the parking task, position the vehicle midway between the uprights with the entire vehicle within the space.

sec02-card-sec02-R08.front: Which three contact or boundary mistakes are strictly forbidden during the parallel-parking task?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.expected_back: The parking task prohibits touching either upright, crossing the painted boundary or driving onto or over the curb.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.front: How many tries and how many positioning adjustments do you get during parallel parking?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.expected_back: The applicant has one parallel-parking attempt and may make no more than three adjustments.

sec02-card-sec02-R10.front: Under what strict condition can you test in a car equipped with an automatic self-parking feature?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.expected_back: A vehicle with a self-parking system may be used for testing only while that feature is switched off and remains unused throughout the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-R11.front: Who is allowed to ride inside the vehicle with you during the Pennsylvania road test?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.expected_back: The examiner is the only passenger permitted during the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-R12.front: What does the examiner explain to you right at the start of the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-R12.expected_back: At the start of the road test, the examiner tells the applicant the route and required maneuvers.

sec02-card-sec02-R13.front: Compliance with which three roadside traffic controls does the examiner closely watch during your drive?
sec02-card-sec02-R13.expected_back: The examiner observes compliance with warning signs, stop signs and traffic lights during the driving test.

sec02-card-sec02-R14.front: Alongside smooth vehicle control, what driver-to-driver communication habit is graded throughout the road test?
sec02-card-sec02-R14.expected_back: Vehicle control and use of turn signals to communicate with other drivers are evaluated during the road test.

sec02-card-sec02-R15.front: When do you receive your driver license if you pass the road test at a PennDOT Driver License Center?
sec02-card-sec02-R15.expected_back: An applicant passing the road test at a PennDOT Driver License Center receives the driver license at that time.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.front: How many days must a driver under eighteen wait before retaking a failed road test?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.expected_back: A driver younger than eighteen who fails the road test must wait seven days before retesting.

sec02-card-sec02-R17.front: How many road-test tries does a single learner permit give you before it expires?
sec02-card-sec02-R17.expected_back: Each learner permit allows three road-test attempts before the permit expires.

sec02-card-sec02-R18.front: What must an applicant do if they fail the road test a third time?
sec02-card-sec02-R18.expected_back: After a third road-test failure, the applicant must reapply to extend the learner permit.

sec02-card-sec02-R19.front: Which specific PennDOT form handles an expired non-commercial permit or three failed road-test attempts?
sec02-card-sec02-R19.expected_back: Three failed road-test attempts or permit expiration can be addressed by obtaining DL-thirty-one for the non-commercial learner permit.

sec02-card-sec02-R20.front: What happens if you still have not taken or passed the road test three years after your medical physical?
sec02-card-sec02-R20.expected_back: If the road test has not been taken or passed within three years after the physical examination, the applicant must file a new DL-one hundred eighty application and retake the knowledge test.

sec02-card-sec02-R21.front: How does skipping turn signals affect your Pennsylvania road-test outcome?
sec02-card-sec02-R21.expected_back: Not using turn signals is among the listed reasons for road-test failure.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.front: Which two types of intersection movements do traffic signals regulate?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.expected_back: Traffic signals control vehicle and pedestrian movements at intersections.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.front: Where are red and green positioned on a vertical traffic light?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.expected_back: On a vertically arranged traffic signal, red occupies the top position and green the bottom.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.front: Where do red and green appear on a horizontal traffic light?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.expected_back: On a horizontal traffic signal, red appears at the left and green at the right.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.front: Where must you bring your vehicle to a halt at a steady red light?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.expected_back: A steady red light requires stopping before the marked stop line or crosswalk, or before entering the intersection when neither is marked.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.front: Once stopped at a steady red light, how long must you wait if no lawful turn on red applies?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.expected_back: After stopping for a steady red light, wait for green unless an allowed turn on red applies.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.front: Under what conditions may you turn right at a steady red light in Pennsylvania?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.expected_back: A right turn on red is allowed only after stopping and yielding to pedestrians and traffic, unless a posted sign prohibits that turn.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.front: When does Pennsylvania allow a left turn on a steady red light?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.expected_back: A left turn on red is allowed after stopping and yielding from the left lane of a one-way street onto another one-way street unless a sign prohibits the turn.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.front: What upcoming signal change does a steady yellow light warn you about?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.expected_back: A steady yellow light warns that a steady red signal is approaching.

sec03-card-sec03-F09.front: How should you respond when approaching a steady yellow light, and when may you continue through?
sec03-card-sec03-F09.expected_back: On approaching a yellow light, reduce speed and prepare to stop, but continue carefully if already in the intersection or unable to stop safely before entering.

sec03-card-sec03-F10.front: When does a steady green light allow you to drive straight through an intersection?
sec03-card-sec03-F10.expected_back: A steady green light permits proceeding through the intersection when the way is clear.

sec03-card-sec03-F11.front: What restrictions and yield duties apply when turning on a steady green light?
sec03-card-sec03-F11.expected_back: With a steady green light, turns are allowed unless a sign prohibits them, and turning drivers must yield to vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection.

sec03-card-sec03-F12.front: After stopping for a steady red arrow in Pennsylvania, what turn-on-red rule applies?
sec03-card-sec03-F12.expected_back: A steady red arrow requires stopping and normally forbids movement in its direction, but it permits the same lawful turns on red as a steady red light.

sec03-card-sec03-F13.front: What specific sign, lane, and yield limits govern turning after stopping at a steady red arrow?
sec03-card-sec03-F13.expected_back: After stopping for a red arrow, an otherwise permitted turn must yield to pedestrians and traffic, with a right turn barred by a prohibition sign and a left turn limited to the left lane between one-way streets without a prohibiting sign.

sec03-card-sec03-F14.front: What does a steady yellow arrow tell drivers about the current turn phase?
sec03-card-sec03-F14.expected_back: A steady yellow arrow warns that the movement allowed by the green or flashing yellow arrow is ending and will soon face red.

sec03-card-sec03-F15.front: What must you do when facing a steady yellow arrow, and when can you finish your turn?
sec03-card-sec03-F15.expected_back: When facing a steady yellow arrow, prepare to stop before entering, but a turn begun under the preceding arrow may be completed cautiously if already inside or unable to stop safely before entry.

sec03-card-sec03-F16.front: Why can you turn in the direction of a green arrow without oncoming conflict?
sec03-card-sec03-F16.expected_back: A green arrow permits a turn in its indicated direction while opposing traffic is stopped by red.

sec03-card-sec03-F17.front: How do your right-of-way duties shift when a green turn arrow switches to an ordinary green ball?
sec03-card-sec03-F17.expected_back: If a green arrow changes to an ordinary green light, the turn remains allowed only after yielding to pedestrians and opposing traffic.

sec03-card-sec03-F18.front: What three actions are required when approaching a flashing yellow traffic light?
sec03-card-sec03-F18.expected_back: A flashing yellow light calls for slowing down, watching carefully and proceeding cautiously.

sec03-card-sec03-F19.front: What steps must you take before driving through a flashing red light?
sec03-card-sec03-F19.expected_back: A flashing red light requires a complete stop, a check in both directions and entry only after the intersection is clear.

sec03-card-sec03-F20.front: What must you do before completing a turn under a flashing yellow arrow?
sec03-card-sec03-F20.expected_back: A flashing yellow arrow permits a cautious turn only after yielding to pedestrians and opposing traffic.

sec03-card-sec03-F21.front: Why is turning on a flashing yellow arrow considered an unprotected maneuver?
sec03-card-sec03-F21.expected_back: The turn under a flashing yellow arrow is unprotected because opposing traffic has a green light.

sec03-card-sec03-F22.front: How must drivers handle an intersection when its traffic signals stop working?
sec03-card-sec03-F22.expected_back: Treat an inoperative traffic signal as an all-way stop.

sec03-card-sec03-F23.front: What do highway ramp-metering signals regulate, and when do they typically run?
sec03-card-sec03-F23.expected_back: Ramp-metering lights regulate entry to heavily congested highways and commonly operate during peak rush hours.

sec03-card-sec03-F24.front: When may you pull past a highway ramp-metering signal toward the freeway?
sec03-card-sec03-F24.expected_back: At a metered highway ramp, wait until the signal turns green before entering the highway.

sec03-card-sec03-F25.front: How many vehicles may proceed on each green cycle of a single-lane ramp meter?
sec03-card-sec03-F25.expected_back: A single-lane metered ramp admits only one car for each green signal.

sec03-card-sec03-F26.front: How are ramp-metering lights arranged when an entrance ramp has more than one lane?
sec03-card-sec03-F26.expected_back: A ramp with multiple lanes has a separate meter for each lane.

sec03-card-sec03-F27.front: Does a green ramp-meter light give you right-of-way when merging onto the highway?
sec03-card-sec03-F27.expected_back: A green ramp-meter signal does not protect the merge, so the driver must still find a safe traffic gap.

sec03-card-sec03-R01.front: What does a downward-pointing green arrow suspended over a highway lane indicate?
sec03-card-sec03-R01.expected_back: An overhead green arrow pointing downward means its lane may be used.

sec03-card-sec03-R02.front: What warning does an overhead steady yellow X give, and how should you react?
sec03-card-sec03-R02.expected_back: An overhead steady yellow X warns that the lane's travel direction will reverse, so prepare to leave that lane safely.

sec03-card-sec03-R03.front: What rule applies to any travel lane marked overhead by a steady red X?
sec03-card-sec03-R03.expected_back: An overhead steady red X prohibits using the lane beneath it.

sec03-card-sec03-R04.front: What maneuver restriction does an overhead steady white one-way left-turn arrow enforce?
sec03-card-sec03-R04.expected_back: A steady white one-way left-turn arrow over a lane restricts traffic in that lane to left turns.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.front: How is a lane marked by an overhead steady white two-way left-turn arrow used?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.expected_back: A steady white two-way left-turn arrow marks a lane used only for left turns and shared with opposing left-turning traffic.

sec03-card-sec03-R06.front: Which word and symbol displays govern pedestrians at signalized crosswalks?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.expected_back: Pedestrians must follow WALK and DON'T WALK indications or their walking-person and raised-hand symbols.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.front: Which signals must pedestrians follow when an intersection has no dedicated walk displays?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.expected_back: Where an intersection lacks pedestrian signals, pedestrians must obey its red, yellow and green traffic lights.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.front: What must a driver do if a pedestrian ignores a crosswalk signal and steps into the street?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.expected_back: Drivers must stay alert for pedestrians who disregard signals and must still yield to them.

sec03-card-sec03-R09.front: What does a steady WALK display allow, and what hazard must the pedestrian still watch for?
sec03-card-sec03-R09.expected_back: A steady WALK indication allows a pedestrian to begin crossing while watching for turning vehicles that may fail to yield.

sec03-card-sec03-R10.front: What should a pedestrian already in the crosswalk do when the raised hand or DON'T WALK starts flashing?
sec03-card-sec03-R10.expected_back: When DON'T WALK or the raised hand starts flashing, a pedestrian already in the street should finish crossing.

sec03-card-sec03-R11.front: What rule applies to a pedestrian still standing on the curb when the raised hand begins flashing?
sec03-card-sec03-R11.expected_back: When DON'T WALK or the raised hand starts flashing, a pedestrian still at the curb must not begin crossing.

sec03-card-sec03-R12.front: What does a steady DON'T WALK message or steady raised hand mean for pedestrians?
sec03-card-sec03-R12.expected_back: A steady DON'T WALK indication or steady raised hand prohibits crossing.

sec03-card-sec03-R13.front: How must you drive near a blind pedestrian carrying a white cane or walking with a guide dog?
sec03-card-sec03-R13.expected_back: Near a blind pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog, slow down, yield, proceed cautiously and be ready to stop to prevent harm.

sec03-card-sec03-R14.front: What is Pennsylvania's maximum speed limit when school-zone yellow lights flash or posted hours are active?
sec03-card-sec03-R14.expected_back: When school-zone yellow lights flash or the sign's stated time applies, the maximum permitted speed is fifteen miles per hour

sec03-card-sec03-R15.front: Besides a fine, how many driving-record points are added for speeding in a Pennsylvania school zone?
sec03-card-sec03-R15.expected_back: Speeding in a school zone adds three points to the driving record and also leads to a fine.

sec03-card-sec03-R16.front: How should you check for danger every time you approach a railroad grade crossing?
sec03-card-sec03-R16.expected_back: Approach railroad crossings cautiously, looking both ways and listening for trains or warning signals before crossing.

sec03-card-sec03-R17.front: Which four railroad-crossing warnings require you to come to a stop?
sec03-card-sec03-R17.expected_back: A railroad crossing requires a stop when flashing red lights, a lowered gate, a flagger or an audible train warning indicates an approaching train.

sec03-card-sec03-R18.front: Are you ever allowed to drive around a lowered railroad gate or ignore an active train warning?
sec03-card-sec03-R18.expected_back: Do not bypass a railroad gate or disregard a signal announcing an approaching train.

sec03-card-sec03-R19.front: How must you handle a railroad crossing that has no lights or gates?
sec03-card-sec03-R19.expected_back: At a railroad crossing without signals, reduce speed and prepare to stop if an approaching train is seen or heard.

sec03-card-sec03-R20.front: After a train passes, when is it safe and legal to drive across railroad tracks?
sec03-card-sec03-R20.expected_back: Cross railroad tracks cautiously only after all warning signals have ended and there is evidence that no train is approaching.

sec03-card-sec03-R21.front: Even without gates, which two train-approach cues require you to stop at a railroad crossing?
sec03-card-sec03-R21.expected_back: At a railroad crossing, you should stop if an approaching train has sounded an audible warning, or if an approaching train is plainly visible and dangerously close to the crossing.

sec03-card-sec03-R22.front: May you ever stop your vehicle directly on railroad tracks if no train appears nearby?
sec03-card-sec03-R22.expected_back: Never stop a vehicle on railroad tracks, even when no train seems to be coming.

sec03-card-sec03-R23.front: Where must you wait when traffic ahead backs up near a railroad crossing?
sec03-card-sec03-R23.expected_back: When traffic backs up near a railroad crossing, stop where the entire vehicle remains clear of the rails.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.front: What are the three primary categories of highway signs in Pennsylvania?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.expected_back: Road signs fall into three main groups: regulatory, warning and guide signs.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.front: What kind of legal message do regulatory signs communicate to drivers?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.expected_back: Regulatory signs state actions that traffic law requires or forbids.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.front: Which four common driving behaviors can regulatory signs control?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.expected_back: Regulatory signs can govern speed, traffic direction, turns and parking.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.front: What two penalties can follow if you ignore a posted regulatory sign?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.expected_back: Ignoring a regulatory sign can lead to a fine and driving-record points.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.front: What shapes and color combinations do most regulatory signs use?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.expected_back: Most regulatory signs are upright rectangles or squares with black-and-white coloring, though some also use red or are red and white.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.front: What unique shape and side count set the highway STOP sign apart from every other road sign?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.expected_back: The highway STOP sign has a unique octagonal shape with eight sides.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.front: What must you do at a STOP sign before pulling into the intersection?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.expected_back: At a STOP sign, the driver must fully stop and check that pedestrians and cross traffic have cleared before proceeding.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.front: Is slowing down at a STOP sign without bringing your wheels to a full halt legal?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.expected_back: Merely reducing speed at a STOP sign without completely stopping is illegal.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.front: Where must the front of your vehicle stop when a stop line or crosswalk is painted on the road?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.expected_back: When a stop line or crosswalk is marked, stop before the vehicle's front reaches the first painted line.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.front: How should you proceed if buildings or parked cars block your view after stopping at a STOP sign?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.expected_back: If traffic cannot be seen from the stopped position, first yield to pedestrians, then edge forward carefully for a clear view and proceed only after checking that traffic and pedestrians are clear.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.front: Who stops at an all-way stop intersection, and which driver goes first?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.expected_back: At an all-way stop, every approach must stop, and the vehicle arriving first should proceed first.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.front: When two drivers reach an all-way stop at the exact same moment, who yields?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.expected_back: When two vehicles arrive together at an all-way stop, the driver on the left yields to the one on the right.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.front: How may two drivers facing each other across an all-way stop proceed?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.expected_back: Opposing drivers at an all-way stop may move cautiously together while watching for turns.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.front: What geometric shape and number of sides identify a highway YIELD sign?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.expected_back: A YIELD sign is triangular with three sides.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.front: What actions are required when approaching a YIELD sign?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.memory_hook: Slow, check, yield, stop if needed
sec04-card-sec04-F15.expected_back: At a YIELD sign, reduce speed, check traffic and give priority to pedestrians and approaching cross traffic, stopping when necessary.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.front: What kind of traffic opening do you need before pulling past a YIELD sign?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.expected_back: Proceeding at a YIELD sign requires a safe gap that does not disrupt normal traffic flow.

sec04-card-sec04-F17.front: What requirement do STOP signs and YIELD signs share before you enter cross traffic?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.expected_back: A driver needs an adequate traffic gap before proceeding from either a STOP sign or a YIELD sign.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.front: What exact roadway feature does a white X-shaped crossbuck sign mark?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.expected_back: A crossbuck marks the point where railroad tracks intersect the road.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.front: Which regulatory instruction should you treat a railroad crossbuck as giving?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.expected_back: Treat a railroad crossbuck as a yield instruction, slowing and preparing to stop if an approaching train is seen or heard.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.front: What does the supplemental plaque paired with YIELD at a one-lane bridge or underpass require?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.expected_back: At a one-lane bridge or underpass, the supplemental sign used with YIELD tells drivers to give priority to opposing traffic.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.front: What hazard does a DO NOT ENTER sign warn you against?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.expected_back: DO NOT ENTER warns against entering the one-way street or ramp from the direction of approach.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.front: Where are WRONG WAY signs placed, and what mistake do they alert you to?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.expected_back: WRONG WAY signs farther along a one-way street or ramp warn a driver who has entered against the permitted direction.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.front: Which travel direction is permitted where a ONE WAY sign is posted?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.expected_back: A ONE WAY sign allows travel only in the direction of its arrow.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.front: What severe crash type do you risk by driving opposite the flow of a one-way street?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.expected_back: Driving against the direction of a one-way street creates a risk of a head-on collision.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.front: How are the two roadways of a divided highway arranged and separated?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.expected_back: A divided highway consists of two one-way roadways separated by a median or guide rail.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.front: What kind of intersection ahead does a regulatory DIVIDED HIGHWAY sign announce?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.expected_back: A DIVIDED HIGHWAY sign indicates that the current road intersects a divided highway.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.front: At a signed divided-highway intersection, which turn does each roadway allow?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.expected_back: At the divided-highway intersection described by the sign, the first roadway allows only a right turn and the second only a left turn.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.front: What rule do NO TRUCKS, NO BICYCLES, and NO PEDESTRIAN CROSSING signs enforce?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.expected_back: NO TRUCKS, NO BICYCLES and NO PEDESTRIAN CROSSING signs prohibit the indicated road user from using the posted roadway.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.front: What maneuver does a NO U-TURN sign forbid?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.expected_back: A NO U-TURN sign prohibits turning around to travel in the opposite direction.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.front: What maneuver is illegal at an intersection posted with a NO RIGHT TURN sign?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.expected_back: A NO RIGHT TURN sign forbids a right turn at the signed intersection.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.front: What maneuver is illegal at an intersection posted with a NO LEFT TURN sign?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.expected_back: A NO LEFT TURN sign forbids a left turn at the signed intersection.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.front: What restriction applies wherever a NO PARKING sign is posted?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.expected_back: A NO PARKING sign prohibits parking at the location where it is posted.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.front: What overtaking move does a DO NOT PASS regulatory sign forbid?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.expected_back: DO NOT PASS prohibits passing a vehicle traveling in the same direction.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.front: What do directional lane-use signs posted at or near intersections tell drivers?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.expected_back: Directional lane-use signs at or near intersections show the maneuvers allowed from the lanes they control.

sec04-card-sec04-F34.front: How does a left-turn-only lane differ from a neighboring lane signed with both left and straight arrows?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.expected_back: A left-turn-only lane requires a left turn, while an adjacent lane signed for left or straight permits either movement.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.front: Who shares a center lane signed LEFT TURN ONLY, and which two uses are banned inside it?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.expected_back: A center lane marked LEFT TURN ONLY is shared by left-turning vehicles from both directions and cannot be used for through travel or passing.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.front: Which warning sign is frequently paired across the road from a regulatory DO NOT PASS sign?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.expected_back: The DO NOT PASS sign is often paired with a yellow pennant marking a no-passing zone.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.front: On which side of a median island or divider must you drive when facing a KEEP RIGHT sign?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.expected_back: KEEP RIGHT signs direct traffic to pass on the right side of the island or divider.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.front: Under what roadway conditions does a posted speed limit represent the maximum legal speed?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.expected_back: A posted speed limit is the maximum lawful speed for that highway stretch under ideal conditions.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.front: How must you adjust your speed when weather, visibility, or traffic conditions deteriorate?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.expected_back: Poor conditions may require a speed below the posted maximum for safety.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.front: What must you do at a red light when a NO TURN ON RED sign is posted?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.expected_back: A NO TURN ON RED sign requires waiting for green before turning at that intersection.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.front: What movement choice do you have when your lane sign displays two alternative arrows?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.expected_back: When a lane sign shows alternative directions, travel may follow either indicated arrow.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.front: What must you do if you accidentally enter a lane marked with a turn arrow and ONLY?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.expected_back: A lane sign combining a turn arrow with ONLY requires that turn at the intersection, even if the driver entered the lane by mistake.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.front: What does a LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN sign require before you turn left?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.expected_back: LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN permits a left turn while requiring a yield to opposing traffic.

sec04-card-sec04-R10.front: Does a circular green light protect your left turn where LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN is posted?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.expected_back: A circular green signal does not protect a left turn where the LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN sign is displayed.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.front: What rule does a LEFT TURN YIELD ON FLASHING YELLOW ARROW sign enforce?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.expected_back: LEFT TURN YIELD ON FLASHING YELLOW ARROW allows the left turn when that arrow flashes, but requires yielding to opposing traffic.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.front: Is a left turn made during a flashing yellow arrow protected or unprotected?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.expected_back: A left turn made under a flashing yellow arrow is unprotected.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.front: What does a RIGHT TURN SIGNAL sign tell drivers approaching a multi-signal corner?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.expected_back: A RIGHT TURN SIGNAL sign identifies the nearby traffic signal as controlling right turns.

sec04-card-sec04-R14.front: What intersection hazard does an OPPOSING TRAFFIC HAS EXTENDED GREEN sign warn about?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.expected_back: An OPPOSING TRAFFIC HAS EXTENDED GREEN sign warns that opposing vehicles may keep moving after the driver's signal turns red.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.front: Who may legally use spaces marked by a regulatory RESERVED PARKING sign?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.expected_back: RESERVED PARKING is a regulatory sign identifying spaces for people with disabilities or severely disabled veterans.

sec04-card-sec04-R16.front: What official credential must a vehicle display to park in a reserved disability space?
sec04-card-sec04-R16.expected_back: Vehicles using reserved disability parking must display an authorized registration plate or parking placard.

sec04-card-sec04-R17.front: What two consequences apply if an unauthorized vehicle parks in a reserved disability space?
sec04-card-sec04-R17.expected_back: An unauthorized vehicle in reserved disability parking is subject to a fine and towing charges.

sec05-card-sec05-F01.front: What job do roadway warning signs perform for approaching drivers?
sec05-card-sec05-F01.expected_back: Warning signs announce hazards or roadway changes ahead so drivers can respond before reaching them.

sec05-card-sec05-F02.front: What shape and color combination do most roadway warning signs use?
sec05-card-sec05-F02.expected_back: Most warning signs are diamonds with black lettering or symbols against yellow.

sec05-card-sec05-F03.front: What shape is the NO PASSING ZONE warning, and where is it posted?
sec05-card-sec05-F03.expected_back: The NO PASSING ZONE warning is pennant-shaped and marks the zone's beginning from the left side of the road.

sec05-card-sec05-F04.front: What do chevron alignment plaques tell you about the road ahead?
sec05-card-sec05-F04.expected_back: Chevron signs indicate a sharp roadway bend in the direction their points face.

sec05-card-sec05-F05.front: Where do chevron alignment plaques appear in relation to an advance curve warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F05.expected_back: Chevrons within a curve follow an advance curve warning, and several may appear along that curve.

sec05-card-sec05-F06.front: How should you adjust speed and lane position for a LEFT CURVE warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F06.expected_back: At a LEFT CURVE warning, slow down and keep the vehicle centered in its lane through the bend.

sec05-card-sec05-F07.front: How should you adjust speed and lane position for a RIGHT CURVE warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F07.expected_back: At a RIGHT CURVE warning, slow down and drive slightly right of the lane's center through the bend.

sec05-card-sec05-F08.front: What speed change and lane position does a SHARP LEFT TURN warning require?
sec05-card-sec05-F08.expected_back: A SHARP LEFT TURN warning calls for a substantial speed reduction and a centered lane position through the turn.

sec05-card-sec05-F09.front: What speed change and lane position does a SHARP RIGHT TURN warning require?
sec05-card-sec05-F09.expected_back: A SHARP RIGHT TURN warning calls for a substantial speed reduction and a position slightly right of lane center.

sec05-card-sec05-F10.front: Where can an advisory speed appear with a sharp-turn warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F10.expected_back: A sharp-turn warning may carry an advisory speed on the sign itself or on a separate sign below.

sec05-card-sec05-F11.front: What roadway layout and driver action does a SET OF CURVES warning announce?
sec05-card-sec05-F11.expected_back: A SET OF CURVES warning announces two successive bends in opposite directions and calls for slowing before them.

sec05-card-sec05-F12.front: How should you respond to a warning for successive sharp right and left turns?
sec05-card-sec05-F12.expected_back: A warning of successive sharp right and left turns calls for substantially reducing speed before the turns.

sec05-card-sec05-F13.front: How many consecutive bends ahead does a WINDING ROAD warning indicate?
sec05-card-sec05-F13.expected_back: A WINDING ROAD warning means at least three consecutive curves are ahead.

sec05-card-sec05-F14.front: What does a ONE DIRECTION LARGE ARROW warn of, and how much must you slow?
sec05-card-sec05-F14.expected_back: A ONE DIRECTION LARGE ARROW warns of an extreme change in direction that requires slowing before the curve as for an intersection turn.

sec05-card-sec05-F15.front: What road geometry does the handbook's ROAD ENTERING CURVE warning describe?
sec05-card-sec05-F15.expected_back: A ROAD ENTERING CURVE warning describes a main road bending left with a side road entering from the right.

sec05-card-sec05-F16.front: Why must you use extra caution at a ROAD ENTERING CURVE warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F16.expected_back: At a ROAD ENTERING CURVE warning, use extra caution because an entering driver may not see traffic coming around the bend and may pull into its path.

sec05-card-sec05-F17.front: What specific danger does a TRUCK ROLLOVER warning identify?
sec05-card-sec05-F17.expected_back: A TRUCK ROLLOVER warning identifies a curve where excessive truck speed creates rollover risk.

sec05-card-sec05-F18.front: Which type of roadway sign may be paired with an advisory-speed plaque?
sec05-card-sec05-F18.expected_back: An advisory-speed plaque may accompany any diamond-shaped warning sign.

sec05-card-sec05-F19.front: What speed should you maintain on a sharp left curve posted with a twenty-five miles per hour advisory?
sec05-card-sec05-F19.expected_back: A sharp left curve marked with a twenty-five miles per hour advisory calls for a speed no greater than twenty-five miles per hour on that curve.

sec05-card-sec05-F20.front: What does a MERGING TRAFFIC warning posted on a major road announce?
sec05-card-sec05-F20.expected_back: A MERGING TRAFFIC warning on a major road announces traffic entering from another road or ramp.

sec05-card-sec05-F21.front: Who must yield when vehicles enter a major roadway from a ramp or side road?
sec05-card-sec05-F21.expected_back: Traffic entering a major roadway must yield to vehicles already traveling on it.

sec05-card-sec05-F22.front: What does an ADDED LANE warning tell drivers about merging at the junction?
sec05-card-sec05-F22.expected_back: An ADDED LANE warning means joining traffic has a new lane available and does not need to merge at that point.

sec05-card-sec05-F23.front: What conflicting traffic movements happen inside a warned WEAVE AREA?
sec05-card-sec05-F23.expected_back: A WEAVE AREA warning means entering traffic will merge while exiting traffic crosses its path.

sec05-card-sec05-F24.front: What roadway change does a TWO-WAY TRAFFIC AHEAD warning announce?
sec05-card-sec05-F24.expected_back: TWO-WAY TRAFFIC AHEAD warns that a one-way roadway ends and becomes two lanes carrying opposing traffic.

sec05-card-sec05-F25.front: Where must you position your vehicle after passing a TWO-WAY TRAFFIC AHEAD warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F25.expected_back: After a TWO-WAY TRAFFIC AHEAD warning, remain to the right of the centerline.

sec05-card-sec05-F26.front: What upcoming roadway change does a LANE ENDS warning announce?
sec05-card-sec05-F26.expected_back: A LANE ENDS warning announces that a lane on a multilane road will terminate ahead.

sec05-card-sec05-F27.front: Which way must drivers merge when a warning indicates the right lane ends?
sec05-card-sec05-F27.expected_back: When the warning specifies that the right lane ends, traffic from that lane must merge to the left.

sec05-card-sec05-F28.front: What two things can intersection warning diagrams show an approaching driver?
sec05-card-sec05-F28.expected_back: Intersection warnings show how roads connect and can warn that the current roadway does not continue straight.

sec05-card-sec05-F29.front: How should you approach an intersection marked by an advance warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F29.expected_back: Approach warned intersections with extra caution, scanning ahead and preparing to reduce speed if needed.

sec05-card-sec05-F30.front: What does a TWO DIRECTION LARGE ARROW on the far side of a T-intersection tell you?
sec05-card-sec05-F30.expected_back: A TWO DIRECTION LARGE ARROW on the far side of a T-intersection means the driver must choose left or right because the road does not continue straight.

sec05-card-sec05-F31.front: What roadway conditions and driver actions go with a NARROW BRIDGE OR UNDERPASS warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F31.expected_back: A NARROW BRIDGE OR UNDERPASS warning means lanes narrow and a shoulder is generally absent, so reduce speed and stay within the lane.

sec05-card-sec05-F32.front: When should you wait before entering a narrow bridge or underpass?
sec05-card-sec05-F32.expected_back: At a narrow bridge or underpass, wait for an opposing vehicle to clear if it is wide or occupies part of your lane.

sec05-card-sec05-F33.front: What two adjustments do wet conditions require at a SLIPPERY WHEN WET warning?
sec05-card-sec05-F33.expected_back: At SLIPPERY WHEN WET warnings, wet conditions call for less speed and a larger following gap.

sec05-card-sec05-F34.front: How should you handle pedals and turns on a wet, slippery roadway?
sec05-card-sec05-F34.expected_back: On the wet slippery roadway, avoid abrupt acceleration or braking and take turns very slowly.

sec05-card-sec05-F35.front: What does DIVIDED HIGHWAY BEGINS warn of, and which side must you take?
sec05-card-sec05-F35.expected_back: DIVIDED HIGHWAY BEGINS warns of separated opposing one-way roadways ahead and instructs traffic to keep right of the median or divider.

sec05-card-sec05-F36.front: What changes at DIVIDED HIGHWAY ENDS, and how must you adjust?
sec05-card-sec05-F36.expected_back: DIVIDED HIGHWAY ENDS warns of a return to two-way traffic, requiring a position right of the centerline and attention to oncoming vehicles.

sec05-card-sec05-R01.front: Why is a DEER CROSSING warning posted on a stretch of roadway?
sec05-card-sec05-R01.expected_back: A DEER CROSSING sign marks an area with frequent deer crossings and a history of deer crashes.

sec05-card-sec05-R02.front: When must you refuse to drive under a LOW CLEARANCE warning?
sec05-card-sec05-R02.expected_back: Do not enter beneath a LOW CLEARANCE warning if the vehicle's height exceeds the displayed clearance.

sec05-card-sec05-R03.front: What two roadside edge hazards do shoulder warnings identify?
sec05-card-sec05-R03.expected_back: Shoulder warnings identify pavement edges with a lower shoulder or an unpaved soft shoulder.

sec05-card-sec05-R04.front: Up to how far below the road surface can a LOW SHOULDER drop be?
sec05-card-sec05-R04.expected_back: A LOW SHOULDER warning can identify a shoulder as much as three inches below road level.

sec05-card-sec05-R05.front: How does a SHOULDER DROP OFF warning compare with a LOW SHOULDER warning?
sec05-card-sec05-R05.expected_back: SHOULDER DROP OFF warns of a more severe drop than a LOW SHOULDER sign.

sec05-card-sec05-R06.front: What two mistakes must you avoid if a wheel drops onto a low or soft shoulder?
sec05-card-sec05-R06.expected_back: If a wheel leaves the pavement onto a low or soft shoulder, do not brake hard or make a sharp steering correction back toward the road.

sec05-card-sec05-R07.front: What actions should you take when you pass a HILL or DOWNGRADE warning?
sec05-card-sec05-R07.expected_back: A HILL or DOWNGRADE warning calls for slowing and preparing to select a lower gear to control speed and reduce brake wear.

sec05-card-sec05-R08.front: Why is TRAFFIC SIGNAL AHEAD posted, and how must you respond?
sec05-card-sec05-R08.expected_back: TRAFFIC SIGNAL AHEAD warns of a signal that may be hidden by a curve or hill, so reduce speed and be ready to stop if necessary.

sec05-card-sec05-R09.front: Why might stopped vehicles still block your lane past a hidden traffic signal?
sec05-card-sec05-R09.expected_back: A queue may remain ahead when the hidden traffic signal is red or has just turned green.

sec05-card-sec05-R10.front: What hazards does STOP SIGN AHEAD warn of, and what action is required?
sec05-card-sec05-R10.expected_back: STOP SIGN AHEAD warns of a potentially hidden stop and queued vehicles, requiring slowing in preparation to stop.

sec05-card-sec05-R11.front: What does a BICYCLE CROSSING AHEAD warning alert motorists to expect?
sec05-card-sec05-R11.expected_back: BICYCLE CROSSING AHEAD warns that riders may cross the vehicle's path and that reducing speed may be necessary.

sec05-card-sec05-R12.front: Which two background colors are permitted on a bicycle-crossing warning?
sec05-card-sec05-R12.expected_back: A bicycle-crossing warning may use a yellow or fluorescent yellow-green background.

sec05-card-sec05-R13.front: What must you start doing at a RAILROAD CROSSING AHEAD warning?
sec05-card-sec05-R13.expected_back: At a RAILROAD CROSSING AHEAD warning, begin watching and listening for trains with enough distance left to stop before the tracks if needed.

sec05-card-sec05-R14.front: What does an advance intersection-and-railroad diagram tell you about the side road?
sec05-card-sec05-R14.expected_back: An advance intersection and railroad warning means the side road has tracks shortly beyond the intersection.

sec05-card-sec05-R15.front: What must a turning driver be ready to do when tracks cross a side road just past an intersection?
sec05-card-sec05-R15.expected_back: Where a side road crosses railroad tracks just beyond an intersection, a driver turning onto that road must be ready to stop if a train approaches.

sec05-card-sec05-R16.front: What does a bicycle and motor-vehicle SHARE THE ROAD plaque at a narrow spot require?
sec05-card-sec05-R16.expected_back: A bicycle and motor-vehicle SHARE THE ROAD sign at a narrow point warns motorists to leave adequate room for bicycles.

sec05-card-sec05-R17.front: Where can a PEDESTRIAN CROSSING warning stand, and what readiness does it require?
sec05-card-sec05-R17.expected_back: A PEDESTRIAN CROSSING warning at a marked crosswalk or in advance calls for readiness to slow or stop if necessary.

sec05-card-sec05-R18.front: Which two background colors may pedestrian-crossing warnings use?
sec05-card-sec05-R18.expected_back: Pedestrian-crossing warnings may be yellow or fluorescent yellow-green.

sec05-card-sec05-R19.front: What shape is the SCHOOL advance sign, and what does it warn?
sec05-card-sec05-R19.expected_back: The pentagonal SCHOOL sign warns that a school zone is near.

sec05-card-sec05-R21.front: What three actions are required when you encounter a school warning?
sec05-card-sec05-R21.expected_back: At a school warning, reduce speed, watch for children crossing and stop if needed.

sec05-card-sec05-R22.front: Which two background colors can a school warning display?
sec05-card-sec05-R22.expected_back: A school warning may have a yellow or fluorescent yellow-green background.

sec05-card-sec05-R23.front: What roadway activity do HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE warnings identify?
sec05-card-sec05-R23.expected_back: HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE warnings identify areas where slow horse-drawn traffic crosses or shares the roadway.

sec05-card-sec05-R24.front: What two types of roadside dangers do striped hazard markers identify?
sec05-card-sec05-R24.expected_back: Roadside hazard markers may warn of structures near the road or dangerous edge conditions such as a drop-off.

sec05-card-sec05-R25.front: How do the angled stripes on a roadside hazard marker tell you which way to steer?
sec05-card-sec05-R25.expected_back: The downward angle of a roadside marker's stripes points toward the direction to move to avoid the hazard.

sec05-card-sec05-R26.front: On which side do you pass a marked hazard on the right edge versus the left edge?
sec05-card-sec05-R26.expected_back: Pass a marked hazard on the right edge to its left, and pass a marked hazard on the left edge to its right.

sec05-card-sec05-R27.front: Which side may you take past a marker posted on a center roadway hazard?
sec05-card-sec05-R27.expected_back: A marker for a center hazard permits passing it on either the left or right.

sec05-card-sec05-R28.front: How do work-zone warning diamonds differ visually from standard roadway warnings?
sec05-card-sec05-R28.expected_back: Work-zone warnings are normally orange diamonds with black lettering rather than yellow warning signs.

sec05-card-sec05-R29.front: What activities do work-zone warnings mark, and how must drivers respond?
sec05-card-sec05-R29.expected_back: Work-zone signs mark maintenance, construction or utility areas that may contain workers or equipment near the road, so stay alert and reduce speed.

sec05-card-sec05-R30.front: When must your headlights be turned on inside a posted Pennsylvania work zone?
sec05-card-sec05-R30.expected_back: Headlights must be on through every posted work zone at any time of day, including when work is inactive.

sec05-card-sec05-R31.front: What extra penalty applies if police stop you for a work-zone violation with headlights off?
sec05-card-sec05-R31.expected_back: A driver stopped by police for a work-zone traffic violation incurs an additional twenty-five-dollar fine if the vehicle's headlights are off.

sec05-card-sec05-R32.front: What makes a Pennsylvania work zone count as an active work zone?
sec05-card-sec05-R32.expected_back: An active work zone has construction, maintenance or utility workers on the road or the shoulder beside an open travel lane.

sec05-card-sec05-R33.front: How do drivers know exact limits of an active work zone?
sec05-card-sec05-R33.expected_back: Active-work-zone boundary signs mark the beginning and end of that active area.

sec05-card-sec05-R34.front: What does a ROAD WORK AHEAD warning announce and call for?
sec05-card-sec05-R34.expected_back: ROAD WORK AHEAD announces approaching road work and calls for slowing.

sec05-card-sec05-R35.front: What two details does a LANE CLOSED AHEAD warning give approaching traffic?
sec05-card-sec05-R35.expected_back: A LANE CLOSED AHEAD sign identifies the lane closure and its distance ahead.

sec05-card-sec05-R36.front: What does a work-zone diamond reading RIGHT LANE CLOSED one thousand feet announce?
sec05-card-sec05-R36.expected_back: A sign reading RIGHT LANE CLOSED one thousand feet announces closure of the right lane one thousand feet ahead.

sec05-card-sec05-R37.front: Who does FLAGGER AHEAD warn you to watch for, and what tools do they use?
sec05-card-sec05-R37.expected_back: FLAGGER AHEAD warns of a traffic controller using STOP or SLOW paddles or a red flag to direct traffic.

sec05-card-sec05-R38.front: Where must you pay particular attention to flaggers?
sec05-card-sec05-R38.expected_back: Pay particular attention to flaggers when approaching and passing through a work zone.

sec05-card-sec05-R39.front: Why does a WORKERS AHEAD warning demand special care from motorists?
sec05-card-sec05-R39.expected_back: A WORKERS AHEAD warning requires special care because workers may be on or close to the road.

sec05-card-sec05-R40.front: What can happen if highway workers observe speeding or unsafe driving in a work zone?
sec05-card-sec05-R40.expected_back: Highway workers can report speeding or unsafe work-zone driving to police, who may issue tickets carrying fines and points.

sec05-card-sec05-R41.front: What does ROAD CLOSED FLOODING mean, and what must a driver do?
sec05-card-sec05-R41.expected_back: ROAD CLOSED FLOODING means the road ahead is closed by flooding and the driver must take another route.

sec06-card-sec06-F01.front: What do electronic flashing arrow panels warn of and direct drivers to do?
sec06-card-sec06-F01.expected_back: Electronic flashing arrow panels warn approaching drivers of lane closures and direct a move or merge left or right.

sec06-card-sec06-F02.front: When should you start merging as you approach an electronic arrow panel?
sec06-card-sec06-F02.expected_back: Begin the required merge well before reaching an electronic arrow panel.

sec06-card-sec06-F03.front: What does an electronic panel indicate when showing a caution display instead of a directional arrow?
sec06-card-sec06-F03.expected_back: An electronic panel showing caution rather than a directional arrow warns of a work area beside the travel lane.

sec06-card-sec06-F04.front: What role do work-zone barrels, tubes, cones, and vertical panels serve?
sec06-card-sec06-F04.expected_back: Work-zone barrels, tubes, cones and vertical panels guide traffic through changed patterns and away from road-work hazards.

sec06-card-sec06-F05.front: What four kinds of helpful information do roadway guide signs identify?
sec06-card-sec06-F05.expected_back: Guide signs identify intersecting roads, destinations, attractions and services such as hospitals, fuel, food and lodging.

sec06-card-sec06-F06.front: What geometric shape do roadway guide signs usually take?
sec06-card-sec06-F06.expected_back: Guide signs are usually horizontal rectangles.

sec06-card-sec06-F07.front: What lettering and background colors appear on highway and expressway guide signs?
sec06-card-sec06-F07.expected_back: Highway and expressway guide signs use white lettering against green.

sec06-card-sec06-F08.front: How many times is a typical highway exit posted in advance and at the ramp?
sec06-card-sec06-F08.expected_back: A typical highway exit is signed twice in advance and again at the exit.

sec06-card-sec06-F09.front: How do repeated advance exit boards help motorists in fast or heavy traffic?
sec06-card-sec06-F09.expected_back: Repeated highway signs help drivers notice an exit in fast or heavy traffic and allow time for needed lane changes.

sec06-card-sec06-F10.front: What roadside posts do exit numbers match, and what can you estimate with them?
sec06-card-sec06-F10.expected_back: Exit numbers correspond to mile markers and can be used to estimate the distance between exits.

sec06-card-sec06-F11.front: How many miles separate Exit ninety-five and Exit twenty in the handbook's example?
sec06-card-sec06-F11.expected_back: In the handbook's mileage example, Exit ninety-five and Exit twenty are seventy-five miles apart.

sec06-card-sec06-F12.front: What happens to a travel lane marked overhead with an EXIT ONLY panel?
sec06-card-sec06-F12.expected_back: An EXIT ONLY panel means its lane leaves the highway as a ramp instead of continuing through the interchange.

sec06-card-sec06-F13.front: What options does a motorist in an EXIT ONLY lane have?
sec06-card-sec06-F13.expected_back: A driver in an EXIT ONLY lane may change lanes, but must leave the highway if remaining in that lane.

sec06-card-sec06-F14.front: What does an exit-number panel mounted at the top left of a green guide board indicate?
sec06-card-sec06-F14.expected_back: An exit-number panel at the left of a green guide sign indicates a left-side highway exit.

sec06-card-sec06-F15.front: What does an exit-number panel mounted at the top right of a green guide board indicate?
sec06-card-sec06-F15.expected_back: An exit-number panel at the right of a green guide sign indicates a right-side highway exit.

sec06-card-sec06-F16.front: Where do white arrows on a green highway guide board point?
sec06-card-sec06-F16.expected_back: When a guide sign includes white arrows, those arrows point toward the exit.
